mechanism: First real FFmpeg call uses a 1 microsecond subprocess deadline; next attempt uses normal deadlines

before_retry.error: Processing unavailable; retry processing using the same session. ffmpeg processing timed out after 1e-06 seconds; video validity is unknown

target_30fps.warning: Target resampling may duplicate or omit source frames; target count is not evidence of original frame loss

limitations: An intact SHA-256 proves equality to the client's declared byte sequence, not correct camera capture.
Timestamp gaps are heuristic warnings; variable-frame-rate or encoding decisions may explain them.
Visually repeated frames can be legitimate static scenes; 32x32 luma hashes are not source-reference proofs.
True capture-time loss may require trustworthy capture-side timestamps, sensor logs or a reference manifest.
